description: Sample ElevenLabs conversation transcripts between the Maya voice agent and a business owner, used when ELEVENLABS_MOCK_CONVERSATION=Y to simulate a completed outbound call without calling ElevenLabs/Twilio. Selected by convex/lib/mockConversations.ts and fed through the same recordElevenLabsTranscript path the real webhook uses. The `{{businessName}}` placeholder (in `businessName` and in transcript messages) is substituted with the real selected business's name at call time so the mock transcript, extracted requirements, and generated site all refer to the same business.

transcript.message: Hi, this is Maya calling from BuildPilot. Am I speaking with the owner of {{businessName}}?
Yes, this is Hassan, I own the place. What's this about?

Great to meet you, Hassan. We build a free, professional website for your business in about a minutes. I'd like to ask a few quick questions so we get it right. Can you tell me a bit about {{businessName}}?
Sure. We're a Levantine grill restaurant in Al Quoz, Dubai. We've been open for about six years, family-run, known for our mixed grills and fresh mezze.
That sounds great. What are the main services or menu categories you'd want featured on the site?
Definitely our grills - lamb chops, shish tawook, kofta - plus our mezze platters, fresh juices, and we also do catering for events and offices.
Perfect, grills, mezze, juices, and catering. Who is your typical customer - families, office workers, tourists?
Mostly families in the evening and office workers for lunch. We also get a lot of delivery orders through apps.
Got it. For the website, would you like pages like Home, Menu, Catering, and Contact, or anything else?
That works. Maybe add a Gallery page too so people can see photos of the food and the place.
Home, Menu, Catering, Gallery, and Contact - noted. What should the main call to action be? For example 'Order Now', 'Book a Table', or 'Call Us'?
Oh, and please mention we're open every day from noon until midnight, and that we're halal certified.

Perfect, I've got everything I need - grills, mezze, juices and catering, Home/Menu/Catering/Gallery/Contact pages, 'Order Now' as the main action, warm red-gold-green branding, your contact details, opening hours, and the halal certification note. We'll have a draft site ready shortly. Thanks so much for your time, Hassan!
Thank you, looking forward to seeing it.
Hello, this is Maya from BuildPilot. Could I speak with the owner of {{businessName}}?
Speaking, this is Fatima. Is this about the website offer?
Yes exactly - we build a free professional website for your salon. First, can you describe your business a bit?
We're a beauty salon in Jumeirah Lakes Towers. We do hair styling, coloring, facials, manicures and pedicures, and bridal packages.
Wonderful. Which of those would you like to highlight most as your main services?
Hair coloring and bridal packages are our biggest earners, but we want all of them listed: hair, facials, nails, and bridal.
Noted - hair styling and coloring, facials, manicure and pedicure, and bridal packages. Who is your ideal client?
Mostly women aged 20 to 45, professionals and brides-to-be, who want a relaxing, high-quality experience.
Great, and what pages would you like on the site - Home, Services, Bridal, Gallery, Booking, Contact?
Yes to all of those, especially a Booking page since a lot of clients ask to book online.
Understood. What should the main button say - 'Book an Appointment', 'Call Now', something else?
'Book an Appointment' is perfect.
Also please add that we're open Saturday to Thursday 10am to 9pm, closed Fridays, and that first-time clients get 15% off.

All set - hair, facials, nails and bridal packages, targeting professional women and brides, with Home, Services, Bridal, Gallery, Booking and Contact pages, 'Book an Appointment' as the action, an elegant blush-pink and gold theme, your contact details, hours, and the first-time discount. We'll have this ready for you soon, thank you Fatima!
Amazing, thank you so much.
Hi, this is Maya calling from BuildPilot. Is this the owner of {{businessName}}?
Yes, Rajesh speaking. You mentioned a free website, right?
That's right. Let's start with the basics - what does {{businessName}} do and where are you based?

We're a plumbing and general maintenance company based in Al Quoz, Dubai. We handle leak repairs, pipe installation, water heater servicing, and also general handyman jobs like drilling and small electrical fixes.
Good to know. Which services should we feature most prominently?
Emergency leak repair is our top service, then water heater installation and maintenance contracts for villas and offices.
Got it - emergency leak repair, pipe installation, water heater servicing, and maintenance contracts. Who are your typical customers?
Mostly villa owners and small offices around Dubai, and property managers who need recurring maintenance.
For the website, would you like pages like Home, Services, Emergency Call-Out, and Contact?
Yes, and maybe a page about our maintenance contracts since that's recurring revenue for us.
Noted - Home, Services, Maintenance Contracts, Emergency Call-Out, Contact. What should the main call to action be?
'Call for Emergency Service' - we want people to call us immediately if there's a leak.

Perfect - leak repair, pipe installation, water heater servicing and maintenance contracts, targeting villa owners, offices and property managers, with Home, Services, Maintenance Contracts, Emergency Call-Out and Contact pages, 'Call for Emergency Service' as the action, a trustworthy blue-white-orange theme, your contact info, and notes on 24/7 service and free quotes. We'll get this built for you shortly. Thanks, Rajesh!
Sounds good, appreciate it.
Hello, this is Maya from BuildPilot. Am I speaking with the owner or manager of {{businessName}}?
Yes, this is Dr. Layla Haddad, I'm the owner. You're calling about a website?
Exactly, we build a free professional website for clinics like yours. Tell me a little about {{businessName}}.
We're a general and cosmetic dental clinic in Al Barsha, Dubai. We offer cleanings, fillings, root canals, teeth whitening, and Invisalign orthodontics.
Great range of services. Which ones would you like to highlight most?
Teeth whitening and Invisalign are big draws for us, but we want to list general dentistry too - cleanings, fillings, root canals.
Understood - general dentistry, teeth whitening, and Invisalign orthodontics. Who is your typical patient?
Families in Al Barsha and nearby areas, plus young professionals interested in cosmetic treatments like whitening and Invisalign.
For the site, shall we include pages like Home, Services, About the Doctors, and Book an Appointment?
Yes, and please add a page for insurance information since patients always ask which insurance we accept.
Got it - Home, Services, About the Doctors, Insurance, Contact/Booking. What should the main call to action say?
'Book an Appointment' works best for us.
For branding - clinics often go with calm, clean colors. What tone and colors would you like?
Clean and calming - light blue, white, and maybe a soft teal accent. We want it to feel modern and trustworthy.
That will look great. Can I get the clinic's phone, email, and address?
This number is our main line, email is contact@brightsmiledubai.com, and we're on Al Barsha 1, near the Mall of the Emirates, Dubai.
Please note we accept most major insurance providers and we're open Saturday to Thursday, 9am to 7pm.

Perfect - general dentistry, whitening and Invisalign, targeting families and young professionals, with Home, Services, About the Doctors, Insurance and Contact/Booking pages, 'Book an Appointment' as the action, a calm light blue and teal theme, your contact details, insurance note, and opening hours. We'll have your draft site ready soon. Thank you, Dr. Haddad!
Thank you, I look forward to seeing it.
Hi, this is Maya calling from BuildPilot. Is this the owner of {{businessName}}?
Yeah, this is Mohammed. What's this call about?
We build a free professional website for garages like yours. Can you tell me a bit about {{businessName}}?
We're a full-service auto garage in Ras Al Khor, Dubai. We do general repairs, oil changes, brake and suspension work, AC servicing, and tyre replacement.
Solid list of services. Which ones bring in the most customers?
Oil changes and AC servicing are our bread and butter, especially in summer, but brake and suspension work pays well too.
Got it - general repairs, oil changes, brake and suspension, AC servicing, and tyres. Who's your typical customer?
Mostly everyday car owners in the area, and some small delivery fleet operators who need regular maintenance.
For the website, should we include pages like Home, Services, Fleet Maintenance, and Contact?
Yes, and add a page where people can request a quote, since a lot of people ask for pricing before coming in.
Noted - Home, Services, Fleet Maintenance, Get a Quote, Contact. What should the main call to action be?
'Get a Free Quote' would be great.
For the look - garages often go bold and mechanical. What colors and tone represent {{businessName}}?
Bold - black, red, and a bit of metallic grey. We want it to feel strong and reliable, like a real garage.
Great choice. Can I get your garage's phone, email, and address?
This number is fine for calls, email is service@turbotunegarage.ae, and we're in Ras Al Khor Industrial Area 2, Dubai.
Also mention we offer free pickup and drop-off for cars within Dubai, and we're open every day except Friday morning.

Perfect - general repairs, oil changes, brake and suspension, AC servicing and tyres, targeting everyday drivers and small fleets, with Home, Services, Fleet Maintenance, Get a Quote and Contact pages, 'Get a Free Quote' as the action, a bold black-red-grey theme, your contact info, and notes on free pickup/drop-off and hours. We'll have this built for you shortly. Thanks, Mohammed!
Nice, thanks a lot.
Hello, this is Maya calling from BuildPilot. Am I speaking with the owner or manager of {{businessName}}?
Yes, this is Dr. Amina, I run the clinic. Is this about the free website?
That's right, we build a free professional website for clinics like yours. Can you tell me a bit about {{businessName}}?
We're a general medical polyclinic in Al Barsha, Dubai. We have a general physician, a pediatrician, and a dermatologist on staff, plus a small lab for basic tests.
That's a great range of services. Which departments should we feature most on the site?
General practice and pediatrics bring in the most patients, but dermatology and the lab services are growing fast, so list all four.
Noted - general practice, pediatrics, dermatology, and lab services. Who is your typical patient?
Families in Al Barsha and nearby areas, mostly for general and pediatric visits, plus working professionals for dermatology.
For the website, would you like pages like Home, Services, Our Doctors, and Book an Appointment?
Yes, and please add an Insurance page since patients always ask which providers we accept.
Got it - Home, Services, Our Doctors, Insurance, Book an Appointment. What should the main call to action say?
'Book an Appointment' works well for us.
For branding, clinics often go with calm, trustworthy colors. What tone and colors represent {{businessName}}?
Clean and calming - white, soft blue, and a touch of green. We want patients to feel it's a caring, modern place.
Also please mention we accept most major insurance providers and we're open Saturday to Thursday, 8am to 8pm.

Perfect - general practice, pediatrics, dermatology and lab services, targeting families and working professionals, with Home, Services, Our Doctors, Insurance and Book an Appointment pages, 'Book an Appointment' as the action, a calm white-blue-green theme, your contact details, insurance note, and opening hours. We'll have your draft site ready soon. Thank you, Dr. Amina!
Thank you, looking forward to it.
Hi, this is Maya calling from BuildPilot. Am I speaking with the owner of {{businessName}}?
Yes, this is Sara, I run the online store. What's this about?
Great to meet you, Sara. We build a free professional website for businesses like yours. Can you tell me a bit about {{businessName}}?
We're an online shoe store based in Dubai selling sneakers, formal shoes, and sandals for men, women, and kids. Right now we mostly sell through Instagram.
Nice, and what would you like to feature most on the website - specific product categories, new arrivals?
Definitely new arrivals and best sellers, plus our sneaker collection, and a section for kids' shoes since that's growing fast.
Got it - new arrivals, best sellers, sneakers, formal shoes, and kids' shoes. Who is your typical customer?
Mostly families and young adults aged 18 to 40 in the UAE, but we do get some international orders too, especially for the sneaker collection.
For the website, would you like pages like Home, Shop, New Arrivals, About, and Contact?
Yes, and please add a Size Guide page since customers always ask about sizing.
Noted - Home, Shop, New Arrivals, Size Guide, About, Contact. What should the main call to action be?
'Shop Now' would be perfect.
For the look and feel, what colors and style represent {{businessName}}?
Bold and modern - black, white, and a red accent. We want it to feel sporty and energetic.
Also please mention we ship across the UAE and internationally, and offer cash on delivery within Dubai.

Perfect - new arrivals, best sellers, sneakers, formal shoes and kids' shoes, targeting families and young adults locally and internationally, with Home, Shop, New Arrivals, Size Guide, About and Contact pages, 'Shop Now' as the action, a bold black-white-red theme, your contact details, and notes on UAE/international shipping and cash on delivery. We'll have your draft site ready soon, thank you Sara!
Amazing, thank you so much.
Hi, this is Maya calling from BuildPilot. Is this the owner of {{businessName}}?
Yes, Omar here. You mentioned a free website, right?
That's right. Let's start with the basics - what does {{businessName}} do and where are you based?
We're a travel and tours agency based in Deira, Dubai. We organize desert safaris, city tours, dhow cruises, and we also book holiday packages abroad.
Sounds exciting. Which of those should we feature most prominently?
Desert safaris are our top seller, then dhow cruises and city tours, but we also want holiday packages listed since that's growing.
Got it - desert safaris, city tours, dhow cruises, and holiday packages. Who is your typical customer?
Mostly tourists visiting Dubai, but also local residents booking weekend trips or holiday packages abroad.
For the website, would you like pages like Home, Tours, Packages, Gallery, and Book Now?
Yes, and please add a Reviews page since we get a lot of great feedback from customers.
Noted - Home, Tours, Packages, Gallery, Reviews, Book Now. What should the main call to action be?
'Book Your Tour' would be great.
For branding - travel companies often go vibrant and adventurous. What colors and tone represent {{businessName}}?
Warm and adventurous - orange, sand, and deep blue, like the desert and the sea. We want it to feel exciting.
Also please mention we offer pickup and drop-off from hotels, and we're available seven days a week.

Perfect - desert safaris, city tours, dhow cruises and holiday packages, targeting tourists and local residents, with Home, Tours, Packages, Gallery, Reviews and Book Now pages, 'Book Your Tour' as the action, a warm orange-sand-blue theme, your contact info, and notes on hotel pickup and 7-day availability. We'll have this built for you shortly. Thanks, Omar!
Sounds great, thank you.
Hello, this is Maya from BuildPilot. Am I speaking with the owner of {{businessName}}?
Yes, this is Nadia, I run the agency. Is this about the website offer?
Yes exactly - we build a free professional website for agencies like yours. Can you tell me a bit about {{businessName}}?
We're a real estate agency in Business Bay, Dubai. We handle apartment and villa sales, rentals, and property management for landlords.
Great range of services. Which ones should we highlight most on the site?
Sales and rentals bring in the most clients, but we also want property management listed since it's steady income for us.
Noted - sales, rentals, and property management. Who is your typical client?
Mostly investors and expats looking to buy or rent apartments and villas, plus landlords who want us to manage their properties.
For the website, would you like pages like Home, Listings, Services, About, and Contact?
Yes, and please add a page where people can search or filter listings, since that's what clients ask for most.
Understood - Home, Listings, Services, About, Contact, with search/filter on the Listings page. What should the main call to action be?
'Browse Listings' or 'Contact an Agent' would both work well.
For branding, real estate agencies often go sleek and professional. What colors and tone represent {{businessName}}?
Sleek and modern - navy blue, white, and a gold accent. We want it to feel premium and trustworthy.
Also please mention we're licensed by RERA and have been operating in Dubai for over eight years.

Perfect - sales, rentals and property management, targeting investors, expats and landlords, with Home, Listings, Services, About and Contact pages, 'Browse Listings' as the action, a sleek navy-white-gold theme, your contact details, RERA license note, and years of experience. We'll have your draft site ready soon. Thank you, Nadia!
Thank you, I look forward to seeing it.
